defs.name: Songbird
defs.blurb: Two independent labial pairs in the syrinx, one per bronchus, each with its own pitch; a throat cavity tracks the note.
defs.role: Shimmering two-note leads, arpeggio trills, glitchy chirps

calls.name: Flute phrase
calls.hint: Wood-thrush style: three notes, then a two-voice shimmer

calls.name: Canary trill
calls.hint: 16 notes a second, each a quick upsweep

calls.name: Finch buzz
calls.hint: Zebra-finch style: raspy, pulsed by mini-breaths

defs.name: Weddell seal
defs.blurb: Laryngeal calls with an extreme range: trills glide down for seconds while their pulses slow.
defs.role: Downlifters, laser zaps, acid-style sweeping leads

calls.name: Descending trill
calls.hint: Several seconds falling from bright to subsonic, pulses slowing

defs.name: American alligator
defs.blurb: A chaotic, very low laryngeal roar through a long, closed-mouthed tract; the whole body radiates.
defs.role: Distorted sub drones, noise bass, impacts

calls.name: Bellow
calls.hint: Two seconds of chaotic roar, rising into full chaos

calls.name: Hiss
calls.hint: Open mouth, open glottis: pure turbulence

calls.name: Water dance
calls.hint: Steady subsonic throb that shakes the water

defs.name: African elephant
defs.blurb: Infrasonic rumbles from huge vocal folds, routed through a two-metre trunk or the mouth; trumpets from a buzzing valve at the trunk entrance.

calls.name: Rumble
calls.hint: Three seconds of infrasonic rumble through the trunk

calls.name: Trumpet
calls.hint: A brassy blast that bends up and breaks into chaos
